records.name: Handwart Unsichtbar
records.biography_en: Has found the missing hand and is still unsure who is wearing the explanation. His empty HyperNorm glove gestures toward an explanation nobody claims to own. A dissonant card asks whose hand would fit inside if the room stopped looking away. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Hand ist gefunden. Ihre Zuständigkeit gilt als unsichtbar.

variant_notes.note_en: Has found the missing hand and is still unsure who is wearing the explanation.

records.name: Herr Wiegehabt
records.biography_en: Is making steady progress toward exactly where he already was. His miniature HyperNorm chair provides movement without an inconvenient change of place. A dissonant card asks whether comfort is the same as consent. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bewegung bleibt dem bewährten Standort verpflichtet.

variant_notes.note_en: Is making steady progress toward exactly where he already was.

records.name: Torhüterin Schlüsselrecht
records.biography_en: Enjoys helping people discover that permission was the missing qualification. Her HyperNorm keys confirm that access exists while keeping it conditional. A dissonant card asks why the person waiting must prove the door should open. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die fehlende Eignung besteht vorläufig in fehlender Erlaubnis.

variant_notes.note_en: Enjoys helping people discover that permission was the missing qualification.

records.name: Aufsteiger Nächstergrad
records.biography_en: Can name the next rung more easily than the reason for reaching it. His HyperNorm ladder names every next rank more clearly than the destination. A dissonant card asks who is holding it while he looks upward. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Stufe ist unabhängig vom Ziel eindeutig.

variant_notes.note_en: Can name the next rung more easily than the reason for reaching it.

records.name: Regelwart Bekanntlich
records.biography_en: Finds it obvious once someone else has been punished for not knowing. His blank HyperNorm book becomes obvious the moment somebody breaks an unwritten rule. A dissonant card asks whether explanation might arrive before punishment. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Regel ist bekannt, sobald ihre Unkenntnis Folgen hat.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds it obvious once someone else has been punished for not knowing.

records.name: Fluraufsicht Soüblich
records.biography_en: Protects the corridor from people arriving with an unapproved manner of walking. Her HyperNorm whistle protects a corridor whose permitted pace keeps changing. A dissonant card asks whether arriving differently must count as an obstruction. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Flur wird gegen ungewohnte Arten des Ankommens gesichert.

variant_notes.note_en: Protects the corridor from people arriving with an unapproved manner of walking.
